claim: tamil-bench's MILU harness caps generation at max_tokens=512, which truncates reasoning-style models before they emit a parseable answer letter, so MILU scores are not comparable across the model field.
source: Code inspection bench.py:47 (chat() default max_tokens=512, MILU does not override it; only indicqa raises to 1024 at bench.py:248) cross-checked against usage.completion_tokens in every MILU sheet.
notes: Rows stopping at exactly 512 completion tokens: nemotron-3-ultra 71/199, nemotron-3-super 69/199, gpt-oss-20b 37/199, gpt-6-luna 7/199, nex-n2.5-mini 11/199; zero for gemini-3.8, qwen-3.8, glm-5.3, deepseek-v4.1, mimo-v2.5, gpt-5.6-luna. gpt-6-luna produced 5 no-letter rows: 2 empty, 2 English CoT preambles cut mid-sentence, 1 Tamil 'cannot determine'. Raising the cap changes the benchmark definition, so it invalidates cross-model MILU comparison unless every model is re-run.
